Dr Khurshid Ahmad Mir
Dear Students/Aspirants,
Welcome to the Department of Political Science at Amar Singh College, Srinagar.
In an era of rapid global shifts, Political Science stands as a foundational discipline for anyone seeking to understand and influence the forces that shape our society. Our department views PSIR not merely as a subject of study, but as a lens through which we analyse power, justice, and the evolving world order.
For our students, the discipline offers a spectrum of rewarding career dimensions:
A Strategic Choice for Civil Services (IAS/KAS):
PSIR remains one of the most popular and successful choices for the UPSC/JKPSC exams. Its massive overlap with General Studies: covering the Constitution, Governance, and International Relations, equips our students with a significant head start in their pursuit of public service.
Diplomacy, Peace, and Conflict:
With a focus on International Relations, students can explore the intricate worlds of diplomacy and foreign policy. This path opens doors to careers in international organizations, global NGOs, and conflict resolution sectors.
Policy Making and Governance:
Modern governance requires data-driven and theoretically sound policy analysis. Our curriculum prepares you to contribute to think tanks and government agencies, helping design the policies that impact millions.
Academic Excellence:
For those inclined toward research, the academic path provides the opportunity to contribute to the global discourse on political theory and comparative politics, building a foundation for future educators and scholars.
Our mission is to foster critical thinking and a global perspective. Whether your goal is to represent/contribute to the nation on the world stage or to serve the community through local governance, this department is committed to help you in realising your dreams. We encourage you to move beyond textbooks and engage with the political realities of our time with curiosity and integrity. Let's build a peaceful society, nation and world.
Dr Khurshid Ahmad Mir
Head of Department, Political Science
Amar Singh College, Srinagar
PhD, CIPOD, School of International Studies, JNU, New Delhi.

Dr. Waseem Bashir
Welcome to the Department of Physics.
Established in 1965, the Department of Physics has a long-standing tradition of academic excellence and contribution to science education in the region.
Our aim is to build a strong foundation in physics while encouraging critical thinking, problem-solving, and curiosity. With a committed faculty and supportive learning environment, we strive to prepare our students for higher education, research, and diverse career paths.
We remain committed to upholding our legacy of academic excellence while continuously adapting to the evolving landscape of science and education.
I invite you to be a part of this journey of discovery and innovation.

About Department
The Department of Physics, established in 1965, is proud to be one of the earliest departments of its kind in the valley. Since its inception, the department has been dedicated to imparting quality education and fostering a spirit of scientific inquiry among students.
The department is equipped with three well-maintained laboratories, including a fully functional dark room, providing students with hands-on experimental experience and practical exposure. The department is currently  staffed by the Head of the Department, Dr Waseem Bashir and two dedicated faculty members, who work collectively to ensure effective teaching and mentoring of students.
With a focus on both theoretical understanding and practical application, the department continues to nurture young minds and promote scientific temper among learners. We aim to create an environment that nurtures scientific thinking, curiosity and a deeper understanding of the physical world.

About Department
The Department of Botany was established in 1981 and has made significant progress in academics since then. The Department maintains a botanical garden which has a rich diversity of wild, economically and medicinally important plants. The Department has established a herbal garden and fluoriculture gardens in which many medicinal and aromatic plants are being cultivated.
The aim of the Department is to give the learners a sound understanding of Biosciences with emphasis on understanding the general aspects of plants and their importance. Further the Department aims to provide the platform for students to achieve excellence in academics.  The programme offered by the Department provides an opportunity to learners for higher studies not only in Botany but also in other branches like bioresources, biotechnology, biochemistry, bioinformatics, environmental science, phytochemistry, pharmacognosy, genetics, ecology, microbiology etc. Besides, the teaching-learning provided by the Department, also helps students to qualify competitive exams like NET, KAS and IAS. The programme includes themes in some of the emerging areas of Botany that are expected to be extremely useful in the present scenario.

About Department
The Department of Mathematics at
Amar Singh College (ASC)
, Srinagar, is one of the most prominent academic units within the institution, which is a constituent college of
Cluster University Srinagar
. Since the college’s conversion from a technical institute to a degree-granting college in 1942, mathematics has served as a foundational pillar for its science and humanities programs.

Dr. Wahid Ahmad Sheikh
Assistant Professor
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to the Department of Persian, Amar Singh College — one of the oldest centers of Persian learning in Jammu & Kashmir.Persian has a deep-rooted cultural and literary legacy in our region. At Amar Singh College, we are committed to preserving this heritage while making it relevant for contemporary scholarship and research. Our department strives to nurture critical thinking, literary appreciation, and research aptitude among students through a blend of classical texts and modern pedagogy.The faculty of the department is dedicated to maintaining high academic standards and guiding students in language, literature, history, and Sufi thought. We also encourage students to explore comparative studies between Persian, Urdu, Arabic, and Kashmiri literature.
I invite students, researchers, and scholars to engage with us in this journey of learning. Together, let us uphold the rich tradition of Persian scholarship and contribute meaningfully to academia and society.
Dr Wahid Ahmad Sheikh
Head, Department of Persian
Amar Singh College, Srinagar
Email: [persiangdc100@gmail.com]

About Department
Persian is a member of the Western Iranian branch of the Indo-European language family. It is spoken by about 110 million people, mainly in Iran, Afghanistan, and Tajikistan, and also in Uzbekistan, Iraq, Russia, and Azerbaijan. In 2009 there were about 60 million native speakers of Persian and another 50 million second-language speakers.
In Afghanistan, Persian is known as Dari or Dari-Persian, while in Tajikistan it’s known as Tajiki .Parisian language is written in Cuneiform, Phlavi, Manichaean, Avestan, Persian, Cyrillic, Nastaleeq, and Latin Scripts.
Under Mongolian and Turkish rulers, Persian was adopted as the language of government in Turkey, central Asia, and India, where it was used for centuries, and until after 1900 in Kashmir.
The Persian language remained the official language of Jammu and Kashmir for about 750 years. During this period, it influenced the culture, art, and regional languages of the state and due to which Kashmir is called “IRAN-E-SAGEER”.
The Department of Persian, Amar Singh College, was established in the year 1942 and hence It is one of the earliest departments to be established in the college. We offer a variety of programs at the undergraduate level like B.A Minor Course, Ability Enhancement Curriculum Course, Skill Enhancement Course and Multidisciplinary Course from 1st  to 6" Semesters and the students interested in learning a new language can opt for any one of the above mentioned courses. The course curriculum of the department is updated on a regular basis and it has been recently revised in accordance with the provisions of National education Policy 2020.
The primary objective of the courses offered by the department is to introduce the students to various aspects of Persian language, Literature , Culture , History etc so as to enable them to develop a sense of critical appreciation for the forms of literary genres like prose and poetry. The curriculum is designed to accommodate Indo-Persian Literature in addition to Modern and Classical Persian Literature. Care is taken to impart a quality education in a structured manner so as to promote a solid foundational understanding of Persian literature among the students.
The Skill Enhancement Course, Multidisciplinary Course and Ability Enhancement Curriculum Courses are largely oriented towards developing the linguistic accuracy of the students in Modern Spoken Persian and enhance the interpretive skills of the students, improve reading, comprehension and basic writing skills of the students. This is achieved through classroom teaching and classwork activities like oral expression, class projects interviews etc.
The larger goal of the department is to forge a bright future for the students by guiding them in their academic endeavors and preparing them for their respective roles in the society so that they grow as responsible citizens and work towards the upliftment of society.
The activities of department are not limited to teaching alone. A plethora of academic activities like seminars, webinars, memorial lectures and talks on relevant topics related to Persian language and literature are organized in the college from time to time where teachers and research scholars are invited to deliver lectures, whereas educational tours to historical monuments and museums are also organized for the benefit of students.

Prof.(Dr) Tehmina Yousuf
Principal, Amar Singh College
I welcome you to this institution of higher learning and glorious history. I have joined as Principal in this college in 2026  and feel honoured to serve the student - community through this centre of high intellectual repute. Over the years, it has produced a galaxy of Alumni who have occupied pivotal positions in all walks of life. With the state–of-the art infrastructure and reputed faculty, we are committed to provide all possible guidance to the new aspirants being admitted in this college during the academic programme.
This institution offers courses at Under - Graduate level in Arts, Science and Computer Applications and Post-Graduation in Geography. Besides, the UGC sponsored add-on Job-oriented courses have also been introduced in I) Information Technology, II) Video Editing, III) Computer Application and IV) Web Designing. In addition, there is a study centre of IGNOU offering a large number of courses leading to the award of degrees through distance mode of education.
In the end, keeping in mind the spirit and the philosophy behind the college, I look forward to put our integrated efforts together and receive the cooperation from teachers, parents, students, Alumni and achieve academic excellence and create environmental awareness among students. My good wishes for students, teaching and non- teaching staff of the college.
Principal

About Amar Singh College
History
Amar Singh College (Urdu: امر سنگھ کالج سرینگر, Kashmiri: اَمرسنگھ ژاٹٕھل سِرینگر) is an academic & professional
college in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India. It is the second oldest college in the Kashmir Valley after Sri
Pratap College.
It was established in November 1913 as Amar Singh Technical Institute, to teach willing
students art, culture, and basics like masonry and carpentry. It was formally opened on 29 May 1914 by
Maharaja Pratap Singh. In June 1942, the Technical Institute was converted into Amar Singh College through
bifurcation of Sri Pratap College commemorating the name of the father of Hari Singh, the then Maharaja of
Kashmir. The College was recognized by University Grants Commission of India (UGC) in June 1972. The College
is accredited by National Assessment and Accreditation Council [NAAC] with B++ Grade.

About Department
Introduction
The Department of Computer Applications at Amar Singh College, Srinagar, is a well-established professional academic unit dedicated to imparting quality education in the field of computer science and information technology. Established with the aim of producing skilled IT professionals, the department has consistently contributed to the digital and academic advancement of students in the region.
The department operates under the affiliation of the
Cluster University Srinagar
and follows a structured curriculum designed to meet contemporary industry and academic standards.
Establishment and Growth
Year of Establishment:
2002
Initially introduced as a professional undergraduate programme to meet the growing demand for IT education in Jammu & Kashmir.
Transitioned from the University of Kashmir affiliation to Cluster University Srinagar in 2017.
Over the years, the department has evolved with improved infrastructure, updated syllabi, and modern teaching methodologies.
Teaching and Learning Methodology
The department follows a modern and blended teaching approach:
Classroom lectures with ICT support
Practical lab sessions for programming skills
Problem-solving assignments and coding exercises
Seminars, presentations, and group discussions
Final-year project development for real-world exposure
Infrastructure and Facilities
The department is equipped with:
Fully functional
computer laboratories
High-speed internet connectivity
Updated software environments for programming
Projector-based smart teaching support
Separate practical and theory classrooms
Student Development Activities
To ensure holistic development, the department encourages:
Coding competitions and technical events
Workshops on emerging technologies
Seminars and expert lectures
Industrial visits and exposure programmes
Innovation and startup awareness sessions
Career Opportunities
Students graduating from the department are well-prepared for:
Software Developer / Programmer
Web Developer
System Analyst
Database Administrator
IT Support Engineer
Further studies like MCA, MSc IT, MBA (IT), etc.
Competitive examinations in IT and government sectors
Strengths of the Department
Strong academic foundation in computing
Balanced focus on theory and practical skills
Experienced teaching support
Industry-relevant curriculum
Continuous academic improvement and updates
The Department of Computer Applications at Amar Singh College, Srinagar stands as a significant centre for IT education in the Kashmir region. With its structured academic framework, practical orientation, and focus on employability skills, the department plays a crucial role in shaping future professionals in the field of computer science and technology.

About Department
The Department of Chemistry at Amar Singh College was established in 1942, the same year the institution itself was converted from a technical institute into a full-fledged college. It is one of the oldest chemistry departments in the Kashmir Valley. The department has evolved alongside the college, which is the second-oldest college in the region. The department is currently housed in ground floor the New Science Block of the college.
Faculty Members:
1. Prof. Hina Kausar Qadiri
2. Dr. Mudasir Rashid Banday
3. Dr. Momina Nazir
4. Dr. Irshad Ahmad Bhat (sites.google.com/view/irshadium)
Facilities include:
Three major laboratories:
Physical Chemistry Lab
Organic Chemistry Lab
Inorganic Chemistry Lab
Adequate chemicals and Lab equipment for Undergraduate course
Faculty chambers and teaching spaces
Access to central college facilities like:
Library (~70,000 books)
Lecture theatres and halls

Prof. Masrat John
Message from the Head of the Department
The Department of History, Amar Singh College Srinagar, stands committed to academic excellence and intellectual engagement in the study of the past and its relevance to the present. As the Department moves forward, the focus remains on strengthening both teaching and learning through a balanced and disciplined academic environment.
The responsibilities before us require collective effort, clarity of purpose, and consistency in achieving meaningful academic outcomes. Our approach is guided by principled decision-making, with due emphasis on fairness, transparency, and academic integrity in all matters concerning the Department.
We aim to support our students not only through classroom instruction but also by creating opportunities that help them address academic challenges and expand their intellectual horizons. The study of history, as we understand it, is not confined to the past alone; it enables students to critically engage with contemporary realities and develop informed perspectives about the future.
The Department seeks to foster an open and inclusive academic space that encourages dialogue, inquiry, and scholarly engagement. At the same time, we remain committed to developing essential academic skills among students, including critical thinking, analytical reasoning, effective communication, and academic writing.
Prof. Masrat John
Head, Department of History
Amar Singh College Srinagar

About Department
The Department of History was established in Amar Singh College in 1942. This college was affiliated with Kashmir University till 2016. After that it became a Constituent College of Cluster University Srinagar from session 2017. The Department has produced batches of students throughout the years. Many students of the Department have established themselves in various sectors of public life.

Prof. Mohamad Altaf
HOD MESSAGE
Dear Students,
It gives me great pleasure to welcome you to the Department of Commerce offering the
B.Com (Honours) 3+1 FYUGP Programme under NEP-2020
.
Commerce education today goes far beyond traditional boundaries. It equips students with analytical ability, financial acumen, and decision-making skills required in a dynamic economic environment. Our programme is carefully structured to provide a strong foundation in accounting, finance, taxation, business laws, and emerging areas such as financial services and digital economy.
The 3+1 structure offers you both flexibility and depth. You have the opportunity to graduate with a Bachelor’s degree after three years or continue for the fourth year to earn an Honours degree with research orientation. This approach aligns your learning with industry requirements as well as higher academic pursuits.
Our department is committed to:
Delivering quality teaching through experienced faculty.
Providing skill-based and value-oriented education.
Encouraging critical thinking and practical exposure.
Supporting students in career planning and professional growth.
I encourage you to actively participate in academic activities, discussions, seminars, and skill courses offered by the department. Your engagement and dedication will determine how effectively you benefit from this programme.
I wish you all success in your academic journey and future endeavors.

About Department
The Department of Commerce was established in the year
2010
with the objective of promoting quality education in the field of commerce and business studies. Since its inception, the department has been committed to nurturing academic excellence, professional competence, and ethical values among students.
The department initially introduced the
B.Com (General) 3-Year Degree Course
, designed to provide students with a strong foundation in core areas such as Accounting, Business Management, Finance, and Taxation.
A significant transition took place in
2016
with the introduction of the
Choice Based Credit System (CBCS)
, which remained in operation
up
to
2021
. This phase marked a shift towards flexibility in curriculum, allowing students to choose subjects across disciplines and promoting a credit-based evaluation system.
In
2022
, the department adopted the framework of the
National
Education
Policy (NEP-2020)
, leading to the introduction of the
B.Com (Honours) 3+1 FYUGP
Programme. This reform brought a multidisciplinary approach, Skill Enhancement Courses, Value-added learning, and research orientation, offering multiple exit options and aligning education with global standards.
Throughout its journey, the department has remained committed to:
Academic excellence and curriculum innovation.
Student-centric and outcome-based education.
Skill development and employability enhancement.
Preparing students for higher studies and professional careers.
With a legacy of continuous growth and adaptation, the Department of Commerce continues to strive towards providing quality education that meets both academic and industry expectations.
